panels.visual: The Athenians' annual sacred ship setting sail for Delos with garlands, crowds on the harbour waving
panels.caption: Every year the Athenians sailed a ship to the island of Delos for a festival.

panels.visual: Carpenters replacing old rotten planks with new ones, a pile of old planks beside the ship
panels.caption: As the planks rotted, they replaced them, one by one.

panels.visual: A ship with all new planks and a pile of old planks on the shore, a pair of philosophers scratching their heads, a big question mark
panels.caption: Was it still the same ship? Philosophers argued about it.

panels.visual: Socrates in prison watching a harbour through the bars, waiting; a faint ship on the sea in the distance
panels.caption: No execution could take place while the ship was away. Socrates waited about a month.
